items.title: Show HN: Kapso – Iterative learning from enterprise data
items.description: Hey HN! We're Alireza and Majid building Leeroo ( https://leeroo.com/ ). Previously we’ve built AI systems for products with millions of users, including at LinkedIn and Meta. We’re now focusing on building AI systems for enterprise data. Today, we're open-sourcing Kapso ( https://github.com/Leeroo-AI/kapso ), an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution, and learns from every run. The nature of data work is iterative: investigate, form hypotheses, experiment, and improve based on what you learn. This bottom-up process is the only way to deliver meaningful outcomes quickly in large, messy enterprise data environments. Consultants gathering context in meetings or teams defining a business ontology upfront to fit into the data has no chance of execution, in quarters and sometimes years. items.summary_vi: Vài tuần trước bê bối ngoại tình khiến CEO Nvidia Jensen Huang phải từ chức, ông từng phát biểu về chuyện sa thải và kế nhiệm.
items.summary_en: A few weeks ago the adultery scandal caused Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to resign, he spoke about firing and succession.

items.summary_vi: Hãng chip giá trị nhất thế giới lần đầu thay CEO sau 33 năm, vì bê bối ngoại tình của Jensen Huang.
